for _ in range(self.cfg.decimation):
            self._sim_step_counter += 1
            # set actions into buffers
            self._apply_action()
            # set actions into simulator
            self.scene.write_data_to_sim()
            # simulate
            self.sim.step(render=False)
            # render between steps only if the GUI or an RTX sensor needs it
            # note: we assume the render interval to be the shortest accepted rendering interval.
            #    If a camera needs rendering at a faster frequency, this will lead to unexpected behavior.
            if self._sim_step_counter % self.cfg.sim.render_interval == 0 and is_rendering:
                self.sim.render()
            # update buffers at sim dt
            self.scene.update(dt=self.physics_dt)

def _apply_action(self):
        # Read the previous completed substep; DirectRLEnv updates scene data
        # after sim.step. The final substep is consumed in _get_dones below.
        frame = self._sim_step_counter - 1
        self._consume_physics_frame(frame)
        # Bypass JumpEnv's per-substep metric call while retaining the
        # CoupledEnv target write and foot-contact observation.
        CoupledEnv._apply_action(self)
        if frame == 0 or frame % self._jump_metric_stride == 0:
            self._consume_jump_frame(frame)
        force = drag_force(self.shuttle.data.root_lin_vel_w, self.cfg.shuttle_mass_kg,
                           self.cfg.drag_k_per_m, self.cfg.wind_m_s)
        self.previous_drag.copy_(force)
        self.shuttle.set_external_force_and_torque(force[:, None], torch.zeros_like(force[:, None]), is_global=True)

    def _consume_physics_frame(self, frame):
        if self.contact_events is None or frame <= self._last_physics_frame:
            return
        self._last_physics_frame = frame
        if frame == 0:
            return
        self._observe_physics_frame(frame)
        data, ball = self.robot.data, self.shuttle.data
        position, velocity = ball.root_pos_w, ball.root_lin_vel_w
        forces = self.shuttle_contact.data.force_matrix_w
        if forces.shape != (self.num_envs, 1, 2, 3):
            raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected filtered contact shape: {forces.shape}")
        racket_force, ground_force = forces[:, 0, 0], forces[:, 0, 1]

def _consume_physics_frame(self,frame):
        if self.contact_events is None or frame<=self._last_physics_frame:return
        previous=self.previous_ball_position.clone();counts=self.contact_events.count.clone()
        super()._consume_physics_frame(frame)
        if not self._v4_ready or frame==0:return
        fresh=self.launch_done&(~self.launch_signals_ready)&(frame>self.launch_frame)
        self.rally.in_play[fresh]=True;self.launch_signals_ready[fresh]=True
        d=self.robot.data;tool=d.body_link_pos_w[:,self.racket_body_id];q=d.body_link_quat_w[:,self.racket_body_id]
        forces=self.shuttle_contact.data.force_matrix_w[:,0]
        net=self.scene.sensors['inverse_net'].data.force_matrix_w[:,0]
        racket_force,ground_force=forces[:,0],forces[:,1]
        touching=racket_force.norm(dim=-1)>PHYSICS['contact_force_threshold_n']
        point=self.shuttle_contact.data.contact_pos_w[:,0,0]
        local=quat_rotate(torch.cat((q[:,:1],-q[:,1:]),-1),torch.nan_to_num(point)-tool)

conclusion: The action hook consumes the previous completed physics frame. Contact detection and point_velocity_mps both read that completed frame; the contact record is not an immediately pre-impact velocity.
limitations: No exact pre-impact racket velocity was saved. Separated100Hz samples establish earlier motion only; they do not isolate recoil or bound intervening motion.
